app.title: NameSnipe
app.subtitle: A safe local-first Python TUI/CLI for searching, checking, and registering domains through Cloudflare Registrar API.
app.safety_line: Local-first. No database. No telemetry. Dry-run by default.

init.explain.account_id: Your Cloudflare Account ID tells NameSnipe which Cloudflare account to use. Cloudflare docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/setup/find-account-and-zone-ids/ Dashboard: https://dash.cloudflare.com/
init.explain.api_token: Your Cloudflare API Token authorizes local Registrar API calls. On the custom token page: set Permission to Account > Registrar > Edit/Write; set Account Resources to Include > your account, or All accounts if you intentionally want the token to cover every account; leave Client IP Address Filtering empty unless you have a fixed trusted IP. Requirements: the account must have Registrar API access, billing must have a valid default payment method, and the account must have a default registrant contact plus accepted Domain Registration Agreement. Registrar API docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/registrar/registrar-api/ Token docs: https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/api/get-started/create-token/ Dashboard: https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens It will be saved only in this local JSON file: {path}
init.explain.max_price: Per-domain budget guard. If one domain costs more than this USD amount, NameSnipe rejects it before planning or buying.
init.explain.max_total: Batch budget guard. If the total estimated registration cost is above this USD amount, NameSnipe aborts the plan or live purchase.
init.explain.tld_ignorelist: Comma-separated TLDs NameSnipe should ignore, for example zip,mov. Domains ending in these suffixes are filtered out before search planning and rejected before purchase planning. Leave this empty if you do not want to ignore any suffix.
init.explain.auto_renew: Auto-renew controls whether newly registered domains should renew automatically at Cloudflare. Keep this disabled unless you explicitly want future renewals.
init.explain.dry_run: Dry-run means NameSnipe shows what it would do without sending billable registration requests. Keep this enabled; live purchase still requires --live and an exact confirmation phrase.
cli.check.help: Check domain availability and prices in real time.
cli.plan.help: Create a local purchase plan JSON file.
cli.buy.help: Execute a dry-run or confirmed live purchase from a plan.
cli.help.title: NameSnipe help
cli.help.footer: Use namesnipe <command> --help for detailed command options.
cli.tlds.help: Comma-separated TLDs to search. Configured ignored suffixes are filtered out.
cli.file.help: Read domains from a text file.
cli.live.help: Send live billable registration requests after confirmation.
tui.start_here: Start here: configure Account ID and Token, test the token, then search -> check -> plan. Live purchase is never one click.
tui.workflow_hint: Workflow: Config saves local JSON. Search finds candidates. Check verifies availability and price. Plan writes namesnipe-plan.json. Buy runs dry-run by default and requires live mode plus the exact confirmation phrase before any billable request.
tui.search_help: Enter a keyword and TLDs to search, then run search. Configured ignored suffixes are filtered out. These are candidates only.
tui.check_help: Paste domains here, one per line, or import from Search. Check is the authoritative step before planning.
tui.plan_help: Use the domains from the Check page to create a local plan. NameSnipe re-checks availability and price, rejects premium domains, ignored suffixes, and anything over budget, then saves namesnipe-plan.json automatically.
tui.buy_help: Review the current plan here. Dry-run does not charge anything. For a live purchase, turn on live purchase, type the confirmation phrase exactly, and NameSnipe will re-check price and status before registering.
tui.config_help: Set everything here. Values are saved to ./namesnipe-config.json in this run directory.
tui.config_links: Cloudflare links: Account ID docs https://developers.cloudflare.com/fundamentals/setup/find-account-and-zone-ids/ | Token page https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens
tui.working: Working... this may take a few seconds.
tui.restart_required: Restart TUI to apply language changes everywhere.
tui.placeholder: This first version wires the local-first safety workflow inside the TUI.

tui.local_state_only: TUI list state is local to this process.
